meta: query { genesis: blocks(where:{height_eq:0},limit:1){hash} chainInfos(limit:1){symbol decimals ss58 head finalizedHead} latest: blocks(where:{finalized_eq:true},orderBy:height_DESC,limit:1){height hash timestamp} }
transfers: query($id:String!,$anchor:Int!,$before:Int!,$cursor:String!){ anchorBlock:blocks(where:{height_eq:$anchor,finalized_eq:true},limit:1){hash} rows:transfers(where:{AND:[{block:{height_lte:$anchor,finalized_eq:true}},{OR:[{from:{id_eq:$id}},{to:{id_eq:$id}}]},{OR:[{block:{height_lt:$before}},{block:{height_eq:$before},id_lt:$cursor}]}]},orderBy:[block_height_DESC,id_DESC],limit:21){id amount timestamp from{id} to{id} block{height hash finalized} call{pallet method} extrinsic{id hash indexInBlock fee tip signer{id}}} }
